name: Type 90
protection: Composite armour; concentrated in Hokkaido (7th Division). Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm only damage optics, external stowage, fuel drums and tracks (mobility kill on repeated hits); PG-7V/AT4/MAAWS/SMAW/NLAW penetrate side, rear and turret roof; Javelin top-attack penetrates; frontal arc resists unguided launchers.
visual_notes: Boxy flat-fronted Leopard 2-like turret with bustle autoloader
Six road wheels per side, side skirts
Mostly Hokkaido; being reduced in number as Type 16 MCVs take over elsewhere
